user.title: SwitchBot Zones
user.description: Take the encryption key from a lamp that is already set up in the SwitchBot integration, or enter it by hand.

manual.title: Enter key
manual.description: Bluetooth address of the lamp plus its key ID and encryption key. The lamp has to be in range of an adapter or proxy that can connect.

error.invalid_key_format: Key ID must be 2 and the key 32 hex characters.
error.not_found: No connectable adapter or proxy has seen this lamp.
error.invalid_key: The lamp did not accept this key.
error.invalid_source_key: The lamp does not accept the key stored in that SwitchBot entry. Choose Manual and enter the correct key.

abort.already_configured: This lamp is already configured. Its key has been updated if it changed.

init.title: Zones
init.description: Segment ranges per zone, comma separated (segments 0-20). The segments between two zones are blended.

data_description.colors_per_packet: 4 is what the SwitchBot app sends. Lower only if packets get lost.
data_description.bottom_up: On: segment 0 and Zone 1 are at the floor. Off: at the top, the lamp's own order.
